title: Chamber real-measurement staging evidence
description: Offline, no-fake evidence for the M1 real measurement-path staging gate (closure plan P2): a real measurement run (start -> in_use -> progress -> completion) across >= 2 PCs with a real SCPI analyzer + Appium device. Vocabulary SSOT: src/application/platform/chamber_measurement_staging_evidence.py (parity-sealed by tests/test_chamber_measurement_staging_evidence.py). mode=template is a blank skeleton that can never pass the M1 criteria; mode=recorded forbids the unfilled <FILL-ME> placeholder anywhere (a placeholder in ANY field, even a non-pass-criterion field such as central_stack_version, is a placeholder_in_recorded structural error) so a half-filled template cannot be relabelled to fake a pass. The full --require-pass gate requires all three: structural validity (no errors), mode=recorded, and every M1 pass criterion met. So a fully filled-in bundle left in mode=template, or a recorded bundle still carrying a placeholder in a non-criterion field, is rejected and never clears the gate even when all 8 pass criteria are met. Structural validity does NOT assert hardware ran — the gate checks shape and self-consistency only; truth comes from operator-pasted, cross-referenced API/WS/log identifiers.

machines.description: Physical PCs in the staging fleet. M1 require-pass needs at least 2 DISTINCT physical machines, counted as connected components of the identity<->address graph: a machine only counts when its identity and address are both real (non-placeholder), and rows that share an identity OR an address — including cross-linked rows such as pc-a/10.0.0.1, pc-a/10.0.0.2, pc-b/10.0.0.1 — collapse into one machine rather than inflating the count. Structural minItems is 2; distinctness is enforced by the two_physical_machines pass criterion.

equipment.description: The instruments plus SCPI/Appium proof-of-life. analyzer_resource/appium_device_id identify the instruments; analyzer_idn (the pasted *IDN? response), appium_session_id, dut_model and dut_driven attest the measurement path actually drove them. The measurement_path_proof pass criterion needs all three strings non-placeholder AND dut_driven true — it checks shape only and never asserts a sweep produced a value.

progress.description: Progress observation transports. M1 require-pass needs via_api AND via_ws to both be true, OR a non-empty documented fallback string explaining why one transport was unavailable. API-only or WS-only without a fallback fails the progress_api_ws_or_fallback pass criterion.

timeline.description: Measurement lifecycle timeline. M1 require-pass needs entries for ALL of start, progress, and completion, each with a real (non-placeholder) timestamp; a phase whose timestamp is unfilled does not count. Enforced by the timeline_phases_complete pass criterion.

fleet_partition.description: A 3+ node fleet split (split-brain) scenario. state is observed (actually exercised) or not_run (honestly declared blocked-by-equipment — never faked into observed, so a partition that could not be run on the available fleet remains a passing-with-honesty state). expected_fleet_size is the operator-declared target (>= 2; the 3+ intent is carried in the value + notes; the honest 2-PC minimum is NOT raised). The fleet_partition_captured_or_not_run pass criterion needs a valid state; notes must be non-empty (silent omission is rejected).
